name: Jersey club 5-kick
desc: Newark jersey club: the canonical five-kick cell over two bars (tresillo bar into a 1-2 stomp bar) at 140, claps riding 2 and 4, and the signature triplet kick roll snapping every phrase end — DJ Tameil / Brick Bandits school. Peak stacks open hats and doubles the roll. Aggressive dancefloor energy.

code.sparse: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.4), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.2)).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd ~ ~ ~ [bd bd bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.22), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.25, ${gain}*.42).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut})).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~] [bd ~ bd ~ [bd bd bd] ~ [bd bd bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ [cp cp] ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.55).room(.22), s("[~ hh]*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.3, ${gain}*.5).fast(4)).hpf(${hatcut}), s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3)).lastOf(2, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
